title: 第11章 我最弱他无敌第12章 我们是朋友了
slug: 狂仙出狱第2234章龙主燃尽
content_zh:
“武爷，您这是干什么？”
几名手下看到武爷跪在地下，大脑一时短路，没反应过来是怎么回事。
毕竟在他们心中，武爷就是最强的存在！
别说花城的人了，就是整个江南也没有几个能惹得起武爷的。
至于陈凡‘编造’出什么武爷在狱中挨打的事情，他们全当是在胡说八道了。
却怎料武爷会有这么大的反应。
“闭嘴，不该问的别问，都给我跪下！
不然，我现在就送你们去死！”
武爷怒道。
他才没有时间跟这些手下解释，因为一旦陈凡发火会是什么样的后果，武爷太清楚了！
没人能承受的了。
几名手下不明所以，但也不敢违背武爷的意思，只能乖乖下跪。
王蟒一脸呆滞，难以置信地看着跪在地上的武爷，整个人石化在原地，不知所措。
忽然，王蟒感到双腿一痛，膝盖后受到了重创，不由自主跪了下来。
“你是白痴吗？非要惹少尊生气，要了你这条狗命才开心？”
武爷踹了王蟒一脚，冷冷说道。
王蟒这才回过神来，疯狂冲着陈凡磕头求饶：“少尊息怒，少尊息怒……”
他也不知道这个称呼到底意味着什么，总之连武爷都要跪地膜拜的存在，一个小小的毒蛇帮惹到陈凡，这可真是自寻死路。
“武世昌，见到我你一定很难过对不对？不过你也别怨我，谁让你那一身横练的功夫那么抗揍呢，当时我想快点儿提高实力只能拿你练手了。”
陈凡说道。

“小人没有怨言，能成为少尊的垫脚石，更是我的荣幸，今后有什么能用得着我的地方，少尊尽管吩咐便是。”
武爷跪在地上，连头都不敢抬，小心翼翼地表着忠心。
挨了不知多少毒打，还要表示感谢！
王蟒听得头皮发麻，凉气从脚底直冲天灵，若非亲眼所见，他绝对不会相信堂堂武爷会如此卑微！
他无法想象陈凡到底有怎样的背景和实力，能把武爷吓成这个样子。
“毒蛇帮一直拿我的家人威胁我，你觉得这件事该怎么处理呢？”
陈凡问道。
“他们该死！”
武爷毫不犹豫地回答道。
此话一出，王蟒顿时被吓得脸色惨白，裆部湿了一大片。
“武爷，不要杀我啊，求您了，给我一个机会吧。”
王蟒跪着来到武爷面前。
啪！
武爷一巴掌抽在王蟒脸上：“求我有什么用？少尊要你死，这世上没人救得了你！
懂吗？”
王蟒不傻，马上就明白了对方的意思，赶紧爬到陈凡面前。
“少尊饶命，是我有眼不识泰山，我真的再也不敢了，从今往后，我们毒蛇帮一定以您为尊，您指东，我们绝不敢往西。”
王蟒哭的稀里哗啦的，哪还有平日里黑道枭雄的风采。
武爷见陈凡没有动手，小心翼翼地替王蟒求情道：“少尊，他以后肯定不敢了，您就给他一个机会，哪怕是当条狗留着为您服务怎么样？”
“我愿意给少尊当狗。”

王蟒为了保命马上表忠心。
“愿意当狗是吗？那我就给你一个机会，从现在开始，我的家人如果受到一点儿伤害，唯你是问！”
content_en:
"Master Wu, what are you doing?"
When several of his subordinates saw Master Wu kneeling on the ground, their brains short-circuited and they couldn't realize what was going on.
After all, in their hearts, Lord Wu is the strongest existence!
Not to mention the people from Huacheng, even in the whole of Jiangnan, there are few who can offend Lord Wu.
As for Chen Fan's 'fabricated' story about Lord Wu being beaten in prison, they regarded it as nonsense.
But he didn't expect Master Wu to have such a big reaction.
"Shut up, don't ask questions that you shouldn't ask, and kneel down!
Otherwise, I will send you to death now! "
Lord Wu said angrily.
He didn't have time to explain to these men, because Master Wu knew all too well what the consequences would be if Chen Fan got angry!
No one can bear it anymore.
Several of his subordinates didn't know why, but they didn't dare to go against Master Wu's wishes, so they could only kneel down obediently.
Wang Mang had a dull look on his face and looked at Lord Wu kneeling on the ground in disbelief. His whole body was petrified on the spot and he was at a loss.
Suddenly, Wang Mang felt pain in his legs, and the back of his knees was hit hard, and he knelt down involuntarily.
"Are you an idiot? Do you want to make me angry and kill you to be happy?"
Master Wu kicked Wang Python and said coldly.
Only then did Wang Mang come to his senses and frantically kowtowed to Chen Fan to beg for mercy: "Young Master, please calm down, Young Master, please calm down..."
He didn't know what this title meant. In short, even Master Wu had to kneel down to worship him. If Chen Fan was provoked by a small viper gang, he was really asking for his own death.
"Wu Shichang, you must be sad to see me, right? But don't blame me. Who made your Kung Fu skills so resistant to beatings? At that time, I wanted to quickly improve my strength and could only train with you."
Chen Fan said.
"I have no complaints, little one. It's an honor for me to be a stepping stone for you. If you can use me in the future, just give me your orders."
Master Wu knelt on the ground, not even daring to raise his head, carefully showing his loyalty.
I have received countless beatings, but I still want to express my gratitude!
Wang Mang's scalp felt numb when he heard it, and the cold air rushed from the soles of his feet to the sky. If he hadn't seen it with his own eyes, he would never have believed that the mighty Lord Wu could be so humble!
He couldn't imagine what kind of background and strength Chen Fan had to scare Master Wu like this.
"The Viper Gang has been threatening me with my family. How do you think this should be handled?"
Chen Fan asked.
"They deserve to die!"
Master Wu replied without hesitation.
As soon as these words came out, Wang Mang was so frightened that his face turned pale and his crotch became wet.
"Master Wu, don't kill me. Please, give me a chance."
Wang Mang came to Lord Wu on his knees.
Snap!
Master Wu slapped Wang Mang on the face: "What's the use of begging me? Young Master wants you to die, no one in this world can save you!"
Do you understand? "
Wang Mang was not stupid. He immediately understood what the other party meant and quickly climbed up to Chen Fan.
"Young Master, please spare your life. I am too blind to see Mount Tai. I really don't dare to do that anymore. From now on, we in the Viper Gang will respect you. If you point east, we will never dare to go west."
Wang Mang was crying so hard that he still looked like the mafia hero he usually was.
Seeing that Chen Fan did not take action, Lord Wu cautiously interceded for Wang Mang: "Young Master, he will definitely not dare to do it in the future. How about you give him a chance, even if he is kept as a dog to serve you?"
"I'm willing to be a dog for Young Master."
Wang Mang immediately expressed his loyalty to save his life.
"Are you willing to be a dog? Then I will give you a chance. From now on, if my family is hurt at all, you are the only one to ask!"
